failure: The BF periodic-die single-notch control did not return one primary notch.

assessment.causeBoundary: Per-column transition selection with interpolation is still vulnerable to fragmented eligible rows and does not exploit the fact that the wafer is one top-connected region while die streets are internal holes.
assessment.successorRequirement: Segment the exterior-dissimilar wafer mask, retain the largest component connected to the inward/top side, close/fill internal die holes, and derive the radial outer contour from that connected region before measuring indentation.
